summary: #124689 remains a valid canonical bug. Current main selects the first matching fallback catalog row even when it is deprecated; a narrow generic status filter plus one regression test is ready for an executor, but this worker cannot modify or validate the checkout because the filesystem is read-only, dependencies cannot install, and required sibling ../codex source is absent.

actions.reason: Implement the generic catalog-fallback status filter and regression test on a writable branch; this worker is read-only and lacks the required ../codex source checkout for the repository Codex gate.
Executor must use a writable checkout with dependencies and clone/provide ../codex before editing and validation.
